name: Marimo
description: An open-source reactive notebook for Python — reproducible, git-friendly, SQL built-in, executable as a script, and shareable as an app.
composeYaml:
services:
  marimo:
    image: 'ghcr.io/marimo-team/marimo:latest-sql'
    environment:
      - TOKEN_PASSWORD=${MARIMO_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - 'marimo:/app'
    command:
      - marimo
      - edit
      - '--token-password'
      - '${MARIMO_PASSWORD}'
      - '--port'
      - '8080'
      - '--host'
      - 0.0.0.0
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - uvx
        - '--with'
        - 'httpx[cli]'
        - httpx
        - 'http://localhost:8080/health'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
